segmentler.metin: San Francisco burned for three days.
It took only a magnitude 7.9 earthquake.
So how could a magnitude 7.9 earthquake do this?
The answer is fire following earthquake with broken water mains — and it is why cities now plan for fire after earthquakes, with independent emergency water supplies.
